question: How many tracks are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM track;

question: Which customers are in Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE country = 'Canada';

question: What are the 10 most expensive tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM track ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List all genre names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM genre;

question: Which tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM track WHERE milliseconds > 300000;

question: How many customers are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer;

question: What is the average track price?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(unit_price) FROM track;

question: Which customers have a company listed?
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, company FROM customer WHERE company IS NOT NULL;

question: List the 5 shortest tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT name, milliseconds FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds ASC LIMIT 5;

question: How many albums are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM album;

question: Which invoices totalled more than 10?
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, total FROM invoice WHERE total > 10;

question: List all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM media_type;

question: What is the total of all invoices combined?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(total) FROM invoice;

question: Which customers have no phone number on record?
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE phone IS NULL;

question: How many distinct billing countries appear in the invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT billing_country) FROM invoice;

question: List every album with its artist's name.
gold_sql: SELECT album.title, artist.name FROM album JOIN artist ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id;

question: List every track with its genre name.
gold_sql: SELECT track.name, genre.name FROM track JOIN genre ON track.genre_id = genre.genre_id;

question: Which employee is the support rep for each customer?
gold_sql: SELECT customer.first_name, customer.last_name, employee.first_name, employee.last_name FROM customer JOIN employee ON customer.support_rep_id = employee.employee_id;

question: Show every invoice with the customer's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT invoice.invoice_id, invoice.total, customer.first_name, customer.last_name FROM invoice JOIN customer ON invoice.customer_id = customer.customer_id;

question: How many tracks does each genre have?
gold_sql: SELECT genre.name, count(*) AS track_count FROM track JOIN genre ON track.genre_id = genre.genre_id GROUP BY genre.name;

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT artist.name, count(*) AS album_count FROM album JOIN artist ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id GROUP BY artist.name ORDER BY album_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List track name, album title, and artist name together.
gold_sql: SELECT track.name, album.title, artist.name FROM track JOIN album ON track.album_id = album.album_id JOIN artist ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id;

question: Which tracks did customer 1 buy?
gold_sql: SELECT track.name FROM invoice JOIN invoice_line ON invoice.invoice_id = invoice_line.invoice_id JOIN track ON invoice_line.track_id = track.track_id WHERE invoice.customer_id = 1;

question: How many invoices did each customer make?
gold_sql: SELECT customer.first_name, customer.last_name, count(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoice JOIN customer ON invoice.customer_id = customer.customer_id GROUP BY customer.customer_id, customer.first_name, customer.last_name;

question: What is the total revenue per billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country;

question: List Rock tracks longer than 5 minutes.
gold_sql: SELECT track.name FROM track JOIN genre ON track.genre_id = genre.genre_id WHERE genre.name = 'Rock' AND track.milliseconds > 300000;

question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT album.title, count(*) AS track_count FROM track JOIN album ON track.album_id = album.album_id GROUP BY album.album_id, album.title HAVING count(*) > 20;

question: How many tracks are on each playlist?
gold_sql: SELECT playlist.name, count(*) AS track_count FROM playlist_track JOIN playlist ON playlist_track.playlist_id = playlist.playlist_id GROUP BY playlist.playlist_id, playlist.name;

question: What is the average invoice total per billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, avg(total) AS avg_invoice FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country;

question: Which media type has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT media_type.name, count(*) AS track_count FROM track JOIN media_type ON track.media_type_id = media_type.media_type_id GROUP BY media_type.name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1;
